remarks: Welcome to 6 Lighthouse Lane. A Raised Ranch with a layout a bit better than the rest. This home boasts an expansive living room, formal dining room, and good sized kitchen. Three bedrooms: Primary with en-suite and 2 closets, two additional bedrooms and full hall bath. Newly refinished hardwood floors throughout the main level. The lower level adds flexibility with brand-new carpeting, a spacious family room with a wood-burning fireplace, and a fourth bedroom (currently opened up, as the wall was removed). An additional flex space that was the 4th bedroom is now with cabinets and countertops enhances the in-law potential, along with a full bath, dedicated laundry area, and a two-car attached garage. Landscaped lot with a covered rear deck, this home offers more space than meets the eye. With a few updates, this home will be brought back to its full potential. Solar panels will convey with the property. Interior of house freshly painted, seller makes no warranties to the condition of the fireplace. House generator included in sale. Professional photos coming Friday!
